# Overview

This script takes code from Amit's thesis in order to get a bit of a structured overall figure together to describe differences between MM12 in terms of taxonomy and predicted metabolism. As the ileum is relatively low biomass and low diversity in terms of microbes we should compare them using both diversity metrics as well as species level analysis and predicted metabolites.


```{r load libraries, echo = FALSE, message = FALSE}

set.seed(1)
library(vegan)
library(tidyverse)
library(ggplot2)
library(phyloseq)
library(ggrepel)
library(gridExtra)
library(grid)
library(reshape2)
source("/well/powrie/users/utu691/devel/Diversity_Transcriptome/R/utils.R")
source("/well/powrie/users/utu691/devel/Diversity_Transcriptome/R/mm12_mapping.R")
source("/well/powrie/users/utu691/devel/MIGTranscriptomeExplorer/R/MIGTranscriptome_plotting.R")
source("/well/powrie/users/utu691/devel/MIGTranscriptomeExplorer/R/MIGTranscriptome_retrieval.R")

```


```{r read mm12, echo = FALSE, message = FALSE}

qPCR <- read.csv('/well/powrie/users/cqh100/work/generated_data/qPCR/mm12.csv', header = TRUE, row.names = 1)
names(qPCR) <- gsub("\\.", " ", names(qPCR))
qPCR[] <- lapply(qPCR, function(x) as.numeric(as.character(x)))

shannon_values <- vegan::diversity(t(qPCR), index = "shannon")
df_shannon <- data.frame(
  sample_id = names(shannon_values),
  shannon_diversity = shannon_values
)

ileum_metadata <- read.table(
  '/well/powrie/users/cqh100/work/mouse_rna_seq/splicing/ileum_metadata_with_PC_correction.tsv',
  sep = '\t', header = TRUE
)

colnames(ileum_metadata)[1] <- 'sampleID'
ileum_metadata <- subset(ileum_metadata, tissue == 'ileum' & age == 'Young' & group == 'Solo')
rownames(ileum_metadata) <- ileum_metadata$sampleID

# we have one missing sample
ileum_metadata <- subset(ileum_metadata, rownames(ileum_metadata) != 'Ileum61')

# map samples from qPCR
ileum_metadata_mm12 <- subset(ileum_metadata, status == 'MM12')
ileum_metadata_mm12$Sample <- paste("Sample", seq(1, nrow(ileum_metadata_mm12)))

idmap <- data.frame(sample = ileum_metadata_mm12$Sample,
                    sample_id = ileum_metadata_mm12$sampleID)
rownames(idmap) <- idmap$sample

df_shannon$sample_id <- idmap[df_shannon$sample,]$sample_id

# get rid of germ free at this point
ileum_metadata_spf_mm12 <- subset(ileum_metadata, subset = status != "GF")

spf_samples <- ileum_metadata_spf_mm12$sampleID[ileum_metadata_spf_mm12$status == "SPF"]

```


```{r read spf, echo = FALSE, message = FALSE}

counts <- read.table('/well/powrie/users/cqh100/work/metagenomics/run4/counts.dir/species_counts.tsv', sep = '\t', header = TRUE, quote = "", fill = TRUE)
colnames(counts) <- gsub('_masked\\.abundance', '', x = colnames(counts))
colnames(counts) <- gsub('^A', 'Ileum', x = colnames(counts))
counts_table <- as.data.frame(lapply(counts[-1], as.numeric))
counts$taxon <- make.unique(as.character(counts$taxon))
row.names(counts) <- counts$taxon
counts <- counts[, -which(names(counts) == "taxon")]
row.names(counts_table) <- row.names(counts)
colnames(counts_table) <- gsub('01', '1', x = colnames(counts_table))
colnames(counts_table) <- gsub('02', '2', x = colnames(counts_table))
colnames(counts_table) <- gsub('03', '3', x = colnames(counts_table))
colnames(counts_table) <- gsub('04', '4', x = colnames(counts_table))
colnames(counts_table) <- gsub('05', '5', x = colnames(counts_table))
colnames(counts_table) <- gsub('06', '6', x = colnames(counts_table))
colnames(counts_table) <- gsub('07', '7', x = colnames(counts_table))
colnames(counts_table) <- gsub('08', '8', x = colnames(counts_table))
colnames(counts_table) <- gsub('09', '9', x = colnames(counts_table))
counts_table_no_controls <- counts_table[, !grepl("Ileum(61|62|63|64|65)$", colnames(counts_table))]

```

```{r split taxonomy function, echo = FALSE, message = FALSE}

tax <- split_taxonomy(counts_table_no_controls)

# filter out human annotations and take relative abundances
species <- tax$species[rownames(tax$species) != "Homo_sapiens",]

# Calculate Shannon before filtering
shannon_spf <- vegan::diversity(t(species), index = "shannon")
df_shannon_spf <- data.frame(
  sample_id = names(shannon_spf),
  shannon_diversity = shannon_spf
)

all_shannon <- bind_rows(df_shannon, df_shannon_spf)
rownames(all_shannon) <- all_shannon$sample_id

# add to metadata
ileum_metadata_spf_mm12$shannon <- all_shannon[ileum_metadata_spf_mm12$sampleID,]$shannon_diversity 

micro_colors <- c("#3288BD", "#5E4FA2")
names(micro_colors) <- c("MM12", "SPF")

# Plot the alpha diversity
ggplot(ileum_metadata_spf_mm12, aes(x = status, y = shannon, color = status)) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.alpha = 0) +
  geom_jitter(height = 0, width = 0.1) +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(legend.position = "none") +
  scale_color_manual(values = micro_colors) +
  ggpubr::stat_compare_means(comparisons = list(c(1,2)))

ggsave("export.dir/alpha_diversity_comparison.pdf", height = 2.5, width = 2.5)

```


## Beta diversity

I think it is useful just to see the distance between SPF and MM12 - obviously they are going to be different but may have some utility.

```{r beta div, echo = FALSE, message = FALSE}

# sort out MM12
mm12_relab <- qPCR
colnames(mm12_relab) <- idmap[colnames(mm12_relab),]$sample_id
rownames(mm12_relab) <- gsub(" ", "_", strain_mapping[rownames(mm12_relab)])

spftomm12 <- rownames(mm12_relab)
names(spftomm12) <- c("[Clostridium]_innocuum",
                      "Bacteroides_caecimuris",
                      "Limosilactobacillus_reuteri",
                      "Enterococcus_faecalis",
                      "Acutalibacter_muris",
                      "Bifidobacterium_animalis",
                      "Muribaculum_intestinale",
                      "Flavonifractor_plautii",
                      "Enterocloster_clostridioformis",
                      "Turicimonas_muris",
                      "Blautia_pseudococcoides",
                      "Akkermansia_muciniphila")
```

```{r spf relab, echo = FALSE, message = FALSE}

# filter as Amit did previously
filtered_results_phylum <- filter_feature(tax$phylum, filter_method = 'percent_sample', 
                                         cutoff = 0.001, prev_cutoff = 3, data_type = 'metagenomics')

filtered_results_class <- filter_feature(tax$class, filter_method = 'percent_sample', 
                                        cutoff = 0.001, prev_cutoff = 3, data_type = 'metagenomics')

filtered_results_order <- filter_feature(tax$order, filter_method = 'percent_sample', 
                                        cutoff = 0.001, prev_cutoff = 3, data_type = 'metagenomics')

filtered_results_family <- filter_feature(tax$family, filter_method = 'percent_sample', 
                                         cutoff = 0.001, prev_cutoff = 3, data_type = 'metagenomics')

filtered_results_genus <- filter_feature(tax$genus, filter_method = 'percent_sample', 
                                        cutoff = 0.001, prev_cutoff = 3, data_type = 'metagenomics')

filtered_results_species <- filter_feature(tax$species, filter_method = 'percent_sample', 
                                          cutoff = 0.001, prev_cutoff = 3, data_type = 'metagenomics')


```

```{r mm12 all levels, echo = FALSE, message = FALSE}

mm12_phylum <- mm12_relab
phyla <- phylum_mapping[rownames(mm12_phylum)]
mm12_phylum <- aggregate(mm12_phylum, by = list(phyla), FUN = "sum") %>%
  column_to_rownames("Group.1")

mm12_class <- mm12_relab
classes <- class_mapping[rownames(mm12_class)]
mm12_class <- aggregate(mm12_class, by = list(classes), FUN = "sum") %>%
  column_to_rownames("Group.1")

mm12_order <- mm12_relab
orders <- order_mapping[rownames(mm12_order)]
mm12_order <- aggregate(mm12_order, by = list(orders), FUN = "sum") %>%
  column_to_rownames("Group.1")

mm12_family <- mm12_relab
families <- family_mapping[rownames(mm12_family)]
mm12_family <- aggregate(mm12_family, by = list(families), FUN = "sum") %>%
  column_to_rownames("Group.1")

mm12_genus <- mm12_relab
genera <- genus_mapping[rownames(mm12_genus)]
mm12_genus <- aggregate(mm12_genus, by = list(genera), FUN = "sum") %>%
  column_to_rownames("Group.1")

mm12_species <- mm12_relab

```

```{r sort spf names, echo = FALSE, message = FALSE}

phylum_counts <- filtered_results_phylum$filtered[,spf_samples]
class_counts <- filtered_results_class$filtered[,spf_samples]
order_counts <- filtered_results_order$filtered[,spf_samples]
family_counts <- filtered_results_family$filtered[,spf_samples]
genus_counts <- filtered_results_genus$filtered[,spf_samples]
species_counts <- filtered_results_species$filtered[,spf_samples]

rownames(species_counts) <- ifelse(rownames(species_counts) %in% names(spftomm12),
                                   spftomm12[rownames(species_counts)], rownames(species_counts))


```

```{r merge mm12 and spf, echo = FALSE, message = FALSE}

phylum_relab <- relab(phylum_counts)
phylum_merged <- merge(phylum_relab,
                       mm12_phylum,
                       by.x = "row.names",
                       by.y = "row.names",
                       all.x = TRUE,
                       all.y = TRUE) %>%
  column_to_rownames("Row.names")
phylum_merged <- phylum_merged[rownames(phylum_merged) != "Chordata",]
  

class_relab <- relab(class_counts)
class_merged <- merge(class_relab,
                       mm12_class,
                       by.x = "row.names",
                       by.y = "row.names",
                       all.x = TRUE,
                       all.y = TRUE) %>%
  column_to_rownames("Row.names")
class_merged <- class_merged[rownames(class_merged) != "Mammalia",]

order_relab <- relab(order_counts)
order_merged <- merge(order_relab,
                       mm12_order,
                       by.x = "row.names",
                       by.y = "row.names",
                       all.x = TRUE,
                       all.y = TRUE) %>%
  column_to_rownames("Row.names")
order_merged <- order_merged[rownames(order_merged) != "Primates",]

family_relab <- relab(family_counts)
family_merged <- merge(family_relab,
                       mm12_family,
                       by.x = "row.names",
                       by.y = "row.names",
                       all.x = TRUE,
                       all.y = TRUE) %>%
  column_to_rownames("Row.names")
family_merged <- family_merged[rownames(family_merged) != "Hominidae",]

genus_relab <- relab(genus_counts)
genus_merged <- merge(genus_relab,
                       mm12_genus,
                       by.x = "row.names",
                       by.y = "row.names",
                       all.x = TRUE,
                       all.y = TRUE) %>%
  column_to_rownames("Row.names")
genus_merged <- genus_merged[rownames(genus_merged) != "Homo",]

species_relab <- relab(species_counts)
species_merged <- merge(species_relab,
                       mm12_species,
                       by.x = "row.names",
                       by.y = "row.names",
                       all.x = TRUE,
                       all.y = TRUE) %>%
  column_to_rownames("Row.names")
species_merged <- species_merged[rownames(species_merged) != "Homo_sapiens",]

phylum_merged[is.na(phylum_merged)] <- 0
class_merged[is.na(class_merged)] <- 0
order_merged[is.na(order_merged)] <- 0
family_merged[is.na(family_merged)] <- 0
genus_merged[is.na(genus_merged)] <- 0
species_merged[is.na(species_merged)] <- 0

# write out the species-level relative abundances
## SPF
write.table(data.frame(species = rownames(species_relab), species_relab),
                       file = "export.dir/spf_species_relab.tsv",
                       sep = "\t",
                       row.names = FALSE,
                       quote = FALSE)

## MM12
write.table(data.frame(species = rownames(mm12_relab), mm12_relab),
                       file = "export.dir/mm12_species_relab.tsv",
                       sep = "\t",
                       row.names = FALSE,
                       quote = FALSE)

```

```{r PCoAs, echo = FALSE, message = FALSE}

sample_table <- phyloseq::sample_data(ileum_metadata_spf_mm12[colnames(phylum_merged),])

phylum_obj <- phyloseq::merge_phyloseq(phyloseq::otu_table(phylum_merged, taxa_are_rows  = TRUE),
                                       sample_table)
phylum_ord <- ordinate(phylum_obj, method = "PCoA")
phylum_plt <- plot_ordination(phylum_obj, phylum_ord, color = "status") +
  scale_color_manual(values = group_colours) +
  theme_classic() +
  stat_ellipse()

class_obj <- phyloseq::merge_phyloseq(phyloseq::otu_table(class_merged, taxa_are_rows  = TRUE),
                                       sample_table)
class_ord <- ordinate(class_obj, method = "PCoA")
class_plt <- plot_ordination(class_obj, class_ord, color = "status") +
  scale_color_manual(values = group_colours) +
  theme_classic() +
  stat_ellipse()

order_obj <- phyloseq::merge_phyloseq(phyloseq::otu_table(order_merged, taxa_are_rows  = TRUE),
                                       sample_table)
order_ord <- ordinate(order_obj, method = "PCoA")
order_plt <- plot_ordination(order_obj, order_ord, color = "status") +
  scale_color_manual(values = group_colours) +
  theme_classic() +
  stat_ellipse()

family_obj <- phyloseq::merge_phyloseq(phyloseq::otu_table(family_merged, taxa_are_rows  = TRUE),
                                       sample_table)
family_ord <- ordinate(family_obj, method = "PCoA")
family_plt <- plot_ordination(family_obj, order_ord, color = "status") +
  scale_color_manual(values = group_colours) +
  theme_classic() +
  stat_ellipse()

genus_obj <- phyloseq::merge_phyloseq(phyloseq::otu_table(genus_merged, taxa_are_rows  = TRUE),
                                       sample_table)
genus_ord <- ordinate(genus_obj, method = "PCoA")
genus_plt <- plot_ordination(genus_obj, order_ord, color = "status") +
  scale_color_manual(values = group_colours) +
  theme_classic() +
  stat_ellipse()

species_obj <- phyloseq::merge_phyloseq(phyloseq::otu_table(species_merged, taxa_are_rows  = TRUE),
                                       sample_table)
species_ord <- ordinate(species_obj, method = "PCoA")
species_plt <- plot_ordination(species_obj, order_ord, color = "status") +
  scale_color_manual(values = group_colours) +
  theme_classic() +
  stat_ellipse()

gridExtra::grid.arrange(phylum_plt, class_plt, order_plt, family_plt, genus_plt, species_plt, nrow = 3)

ggsave(species_plt + theme(legend.position = "none"), file = "export.dir/species_ordination_mm12_spf.pdf", height = 2.5, width = 2.5)

```

# Predicted metabolites

## Main questions to tackle

1) What are the differences in metabolite production fluxes between MM12 and SPF.
2) Do the major producers differ between MM12 and SPF for some of the common meetabolites.
2) What are the correlations between production rate and exchange fluxes.
3) Which "metabolic niches" are present in MM12 and SPF and what imports dominate 
these niches
4) How do dominant bacteria i.e. Lactobacilli vary in export fluxes based on the community composition i.e. minimal vs. SPF.


```{r read mm12 flux, echo = FALSE, message = FALSE}

# Read and process data
net_flux_rates_mm12 <- read.csv('/well/powrie/users/cqh100/work/generated_data/micom/mm12_invivo/net_fluxes_export_only.csv', sep = ",", header = TRUE, row.names = 1)

expanded_fluxes_mm12 <- read.csv('/well/powrie/users/cqh100/work/generated_data/micom/mm12_invivo/expanded_fluxes.csv', sep = ",", header = TRUE, row.names = 1)


net_flux_rates_spf <- read.csv('/well/powrie/users/cqh100/work/generated_data/micom/spf/repeat/net_fluxes.csv', sep = ",", header = TRUE, row.names = 1)

expanded_fluxes_spf <- read.csv('/well/powrie/users/cqh100/work/generated_data/micom/spf/repeat/expanded_fluxes.csv', sep = ",", header = TRUE, row.names = 1)

```


```{r metabolite comparison, echo = FALSE, message = FALSE}

# Load and clean data
spf_ileum_samples <-paste0("Ileum", 1:15)
problematic_metabolites <- c("olsa", "peamn", "sanilamide", "tln", "xtsn", "ppoh", "glyclt", "pront")

strip_compartment <- function(x) gsub("\\[.\\]$|_[a-z]$", "", x)

spf_flux_rates <- read.csv('/well/powrie/users/cqh100/work/generated_data/micom/spf/repeat/flux_rates.csv', row.names = 1) %>%
  filter(sample_id %in% spf_ileum_samples, !metabolite %in% problematic_metabolites) %>%
  filter(type == "export") %>%  # ONLY EXPORT (PRODUCTION) FLUXES
  mutate(metabolite = strip_compartment(metabolite))

spf_net_fluxes <- read.csv('/well/powrie/users/cqh100/work/generated_data/micom/spf/repeat/net_fluxes.csv', row.names = 1) %>%
  filter(sample_id %in% spf_ileum_samples, !metabolite %in% problematic_metabolites) %>%
  filter(net_flux > 0) %>%  # ONLY POSITIVE NET FLUX (PRODUCTION)
  mutate(metabolite = strip_compartment(metabolite))

sample_mapping <- setNames(paste0("Ileum", sprintf("%02d", 62:75)), paste0("Sample ", 1:14))

mm12_flux_rates <- read.csv('/well/powrie/users/cqh100/work/generated_data/micom/mm12_invivo/flux_rates.csv', row.names = 1) %>%
  filter(sample_id %in% names(sample_mapping), !metabolite %in% problematic_metabolites) %>%
  filter(type == "export") %>%  # ONLY EXPORT (PRODUCTION) FLUXES
  mutate(sample_id = sample_mapping[sample_id], metabolite = strip_compartment(metabolite))

mm12_net_fluxes <- read.csv('/well/powrie/users/cqh100/work/generated_data/micom/mm12_invivo/net_fluxes.csv', row.names = 1) %>%
  filter(sample_id %in% names(sample_mapping), !metabolite %in% problematic_metabolites) %>%
  filter(net_flux > 0) %>%  # ONLY POSITIVE NET FLUX (PRODUCTION)
  mutate(sample_id = sample_mapping[sample_id], metabolite = strip_compartment(metabolite))

# Apply prevalence-abundance filter (flux >= 0.0001 in >= 3 samples)
filter_data <- function(data, flux_col) {
  qualifying_metabolites <- data %>%
    filter(!!sym(flux_col) >= 0.0001) %>%
    group_by(metabolite) %>%
    summarise(sample_count = n_distinct(sample_id), .groups = 'drop') %>%
    filter(sample_count >= 3) %>%
    pull(metabolite)
  
  data %>% filter(metabolite %in% qualifying_metabolites, !!sym(flux_col) >= 0.0001)
}
```

## Niche occupancy

It is interesting that Akkermansia for example produces a lot of acetate and is high abundance in the ileum of MM12 mice but not in SPF. The next question therefore is it being outcompeted in the SPF. To answer this we can look at shared niches i.e. bacteria that share import fluxes with Akkermansia in the SPF but are missing from the MM12.

```{r niche occupancy, echo = FALSE, message = FALSE}

species_relab <- species_relab[rownames(species_relab) != "Homo_sapiens",]

spf_abundances <- data.frame(species = rownames(species_relab),
                         abundance = rowMeans(species_relab))


# get rid of unwanted metabolits
expanded_fluxes_mm12 <- subset(expanded_fluxes_mm12,
                               subset = !base_metabolite %in% unwanted_metabolites)
expanded_fluxes_spf <- subset(expanded_fluxes_spf,
                               subset = !base_metabolite %in% unwanted_metabolites)


# create matrices for each species-sample pair and then the flux as rows
mm12_imports <- subset(expanded_fluxes_mm12, subset = flux_type == "import") %>%
  subset(subset = source_organism != "medium")

strain <- gsub(".*_", "", mm12_imports$source_organism)
species <- strain_mapping[strain]
mm12_niches <- data.frame(sample_species = paste0(mm12_imports$sample_id,
                                                  ":",
                                                  species),
                          flux = mm12_imports$organism_flux,
                          metabolite = mm12_imports$base_metabolite) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = sample_species, values_from = flux) %>%
  column_to_rownames("metabolite")


# SPF
spf_imports <- subset(expanded_fluxes_spf, subset = flux_type == "import") %>%
  subset(subset = source_organism != "medium") 

spf_niches <- data.frame(sample_species = paste0(spf_imports$sample_id,
                                                  ":",
                                                  spf_imports$source_organism),
                          flux = spf_imports$organism_flux,
                          metabolite = spf_imports$base_metabolite) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = sample_species, values_from = flux) %>%
  column_to_rownames("metabolite")

# Make NAs zeros
mm12_niches[is.na(mm12_niches)] <- 0
spf_niches[is.na(spf_niches)] <- 0

# log10 the matrices - make them positive now. I don't think
# this should change the inferences
mm12_niches <- mm12_niches * -1
spf_niches <- spf_niches * -1

mm12_niches <- log10(mm12_niches + min(mm12_niches[mm12_niches != 0]))
spf_niches <- log10(spf_niches + min(spf_niches[spf_niches != 0]))

meta_mm12_niches <- data.frame(sample = colnames(mm12_niches),
                               species = gsub(".*:", "", colnames(mm12_niches))) %>%
  column_to_rownames("sample")
meta_spf_niches <- data.frame(sample = colnames(spf_niches),
                               species = gsub(".*:", "", colnames(spf_niches)),
                              sample_id = gsub(":.*", "", colnames(spf_niches))) %>%
  column_to_rownames("sample")
```

## Look at Faecalibacterium duncaniae niche

```{r fdunc niche occupancy, echo = FALSE, message = FALSE}

# is there something that defines that little niche that the 
# MM12 don't occupy?

library(Seurat)
spf_niches_sobj <- Seurat::CreateSeuratObject(spf_niches)
spf_niches_sobj <- NormalizeData(spf_niches_sobj)
spf_niches_sobj <- ScaleData(spf_niches_sobj)
spf_niches_sobj <- RunPCA(spf_niches_sobj, features = rownames(spf_niches))
spf_niches_sobj <- RunUMAP(spf_niches_sobj, dims = 1:30)

# add some annotation
spf_niches_sobj@meta.data$species <- meta_spf_niches$species
Idents(spf_niches_sobj) <- meta_spf_niches$species

spf_niches_sobj <- FindNeighbors(spf_niches_sobj, dims = 1:30)
spf_niches_sobj <- FindClusters(spf_niches_sobj, resolution = 0.5, algorithm = 4)
DimPlot(spf_niches_sobj)

markers <- FindAllMarkers(spf_niches_sobj, only.pos = FALSE)
markers <- markers[order(markers$avg_log2FC, decreasing = TRUE),]
FeaturePlot(spf_niches_sobj, features = "spmd")

meta_spf_niches$fdunc_size <- ifelse(meta_spf_niches$species == "Faecalibacterium_duncaniae",
                                     "Fduncaniae",
                                     "Ather")
ggplot(meta_spf_niches, aes(x = UMAP1, y = UMAP2,
                            color = species,
                            size = fdunc_size,
                            shape = fdunc_size,
                            group = sample_id)) +
  geom_point() +
  theme_classic() +
  scale_size_manual(values = c(0.5, 2)) +
  scale_color_manual(values = species_colors) +
  theme(legend.position = "none")

meta_spf_niches$gchola <- unlist(spf_niches["gchola",])
meta_spf_niches$spmd <- unlist(spf_niches["spmd",])
ggplot(meta_spf_niches, aes(x = UMAP1, y = UMAP2, size = fdunc_size, color = spmd)) +
  geom_point() +
  theme_classic() +
  scale_color_gradient2(low = "snow2",
                        mid = blues9[7],
                        high = blues9[9],
                        breaks = c(-10, -5, -1)) +
    theme(legend.position = "none") +
  scale_size_manual(values = c(0.5, 2))


```

It is very difficult to say anytning specific about F. duncaniae from this type of analysis unfortunately.


## Substrate redundancy

Here we look at which MM12 substrates i.e. imported metabolites are shared between bacteria in the system. At least for mannose, it looks quite interesting because it is only imported by akkermansia rather than other bacteria whereas in SPF it is imported by multiple non-MM12 members as well. 

```{r substrate spread, echo = FALSE, message = FALSE}

sample_names <- unique(mm12_imports$sample_id)
species_names <- unique(mm12_imports$source_organism)
metabolites <- unique(mm12_imports$base_metabolite)

mm12_spread <- list()
for (i in species_names){
  for (j in metabolites){
    subbed <- mm12_imports[mm12_imports$source_organism == i &
                             mm12_imports$base_metabolite == j,]
    if (sum(subbed$organism_flux < -0.000001) >=3){
      mm12_spread[[j]] <- append(mm12_spread[[j]], i)
    }
  }
}

sample_names <- unique(spf_imports$sample_id)
species_names <- unique(spf_imports$source_organism)
metabolites <- unique(spf_imports$base_metabolite)
spf_spread <- list()
for (i in species_names){
  for (j in metabolites){
    subbed <- spf_imports[spf_imports$source_organism == i &
                             spf_imports$base_metabolite == j,]
    if (sum(subbed$organism_flux < -0.00001) >=3){
      spf_spread[[j]] <- append(spf_spread[[j]], i)
    }
  }
}

mets_common <- intersect(names(mm12_spread), names(spf_spread))

to_plot_spread <- data.frame(metabolite = mets_common,
                             SPF = NA,
                             MM12 = NA) %>%
  column_to_rownames("metabolite")

for (i in mets_common){
  to_plot_spread[i,]$SPF <- length(unlist(spf_spread[i]))
  to_plot_spread[i,]$MM12 <- length(unlist(mm12_spread[i]))
}

to_plot_spread$metabolite <- rownames(to_plot_spread)
to_plot_spread$diff <- to_plot_spread$SPF - to_plot_spread$MM12

to_plot_spread <- to_plot_spread %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = !metabolite, values_to = "count", names_to = "status")

to_plot_overall <- to_plot_spread[to_plot_spread$metabolite %in% rownames(mm12_niches),]
to_plot_overall <- subset(to_plot_overall, subset = status != "diff")
to_plot_diff <- subset(to_plot_spread, subset = status == "diff") %>%
  subset(subset = metabolite %in% rownames(mm12_niches))


ggplot(to_plot_overall, aes(x = metabolite, y = count, fill = status)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = "dodge") +
  theme_classic() +
  scale_fill_manual(values = group_colours) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 1, linetype = "dashed") +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))

# diff plot
to_plot_diff <- to_plot_diff[order(to_plot_diff$count, decreasing = TRUE),]
to_plot_diff$metabolite <- factor(to_plot_diff$metabolite, levels = to_plot_diff$metabolite)
to_plot_diff$color <- ifelse(to_plot_diff$count > 0, "SPF", "MM12")

ggplot(to_plot_diff, aes(x = metabolite, y = count, fill = color)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity") +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = group_colours)

ggsave("export.dir/metabolite_spread.pdf", height = 2.5, width = 10)
```
